name: Adele Forgan
original_name: アデーレ フォルガン
source:
The granddaughter of the head of the wealthy Forgan family, and the eldest of three sisters.
She is Hayate’s classmate, and during their time at the Academy, they were fairly close.

Although they grew distant after graduation, one day she suddenly appeared at his office to ask for Hayate’s help.

[b]“…That’s right. I didn’t come here for reminiscence. And of course, it’s not as if I just happened to stop by while on other business, either.”[/b]
